Update ToastProvider and toast notifications in src/components/Toast.tsx so that error toasts use role="alert" and aria-live="assertive" instead of role="status" and aria-live="polite", and prevent error toasts from auto-dismissing after five seconds so they remain visible until manually dismissed.
